questionText: Total drawings of partner #7 during the year were Rs. 70,000. The partnership deed specifies interest on drawings @ 9% (notice 'per annum' is NOT mentioned). The amount of interest on drawings charged will be:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Rs. 6,300 (charged for flat rate without time factor)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Interest on Drawings: Without 'per annum' word.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Accounting for Partnership (Interest on Drawings: Without 'per annum' word):
Rs. 6,300 (charged for flat rate without time factor)

Detailed Context:
1. When the word 'per annum' (p.a.) is NOT attached to the interest rate (e.g. interest @ 9% flat), interest is calculated at the flat percentage on the total drawings without considering the time period.
2. Interest = Rs. 70,000 x 9% = Rs. 6,300.
Hence Option A is correct.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
